title: Unique extension from a single étale henselization stage
statement: Let B,C,A be commutative rings in one universe, J an ideal of B, f:B→C an étale ring map inducing an isomorphism B/J→C/JC, and (A,I) a henselian pair. For every ring map φ:B→A with J.map φ ≤ I, there exists exactly one ring map τ:C→A satisfying τ∘f=φ.

source.place: Tag 0A02, final paragraph; single-stage existence and uniqueness before passing to the colimit

proof.text: Give C and A their B-algebra structures through f and φ. Convert the Spec étaleness hypothesis to Algebra.Etale B C, and use étale base change to obtain Algebra.Etale A (A tensor_B C). The quotient isomorphism e:B/J ≃ C/JC and the quotient lift ψ:B/J → A/I give σ:C → A/I by σ=ψ∘e⁻¹∘mk. It extends φ modulo I. Tensor-product universality gives σD:A tensor_B C → A/I as an A-algebra homomorphism.

HenselianRing.jac gives I in the Jacobson radical. A Gabber polynomial reduces to X^n(X-1), so its value at 1 is zero modulo I and its derivative at 1 is 1 modulo I. Apply HenselianRing.is_henselian to obtain a root α with α-1 in I; no monic factorization criterion is needed. Apply the stated Gabber section-lifting theorem to σD, obtaining s:D → A. Restrict s along C → D to obtain the required extension.

For any other extension τ, its reduction kills JC because τ∘f=φ and φ(J) is contained in I. The induced quotient map τquot:C/JC → A/I satisfies τquot∘e=ψ. Surjectivity of e forces τquot=ψ∘e⁻¹. Thus the corresponding A-algebra section t:D → A has the same reduction as s. For any two such sections, split the multiplication section μ:D tensor_A D → D by the stated étale idempotent-splitting theorem: μ(e)=1 and ker μ=(1-e). Their tensor-pair map p satisfies p modulo I = (s modulo I)∘μ. Therefore p(e)-1 lies in I. Idempotent determination modulo the Jacobson radical gives p(e)=1. The ideal generated by 1-e lies in ker p. Apply this to x tensor 1 minus 1 tensor x to obtain s(x)=t(x). Tensor-product universality then identifies τ with the extension already constructed.

theorem existsUnique_henselization_stage_map
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] (J : Ideal B)
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] (f : B →+* C)
    (hf : AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)))
    (hquot : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap (J.map f) f (Ideal.le_comap_map)))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [HenselianRing A I]
    (φ : B →+* A) (hφ : J.map φ ≤ I) :
    ∃! τ : C →+* A, τ.comp f = φ
